name: Create Chat View Comment
description: Create Chat View Comment Add a new comment to a Chat view. POST /api/v2/view/{view_id}/comment
context:
POST /api/v2/view/{view_id}/comment
Add a new comment to a Chat view.
Required: view_id (path) — 105 (string); body (body)

name: Get Chat View Comments
description: Get Chat View Comments View comments from a Chat view. GET /api/v2/view/{view_id}/comment
context:
GET /api/v2/view/{view_id}/comment
View comments from a Chat view. \ \ If you do not include the `start` and `start_id` parameters, this endpoint will return the most recent 25 comments.\ \ Use the `start` and `start id` parameters of the oldest comment to retrieve the next 25 comments.
Required: view_id (path) — 105 (string)
Optional: start (query) — Enter the `date` of a Chat view comment using Unix time in milliseconds.; start_id (query) — Enter the Comment `id` of a Chat view comment.
